concerns.text: FR-026 mixes unrelated research content (generative‑model question and Schmidt & Lipson citation) with the Monte Carlo validation requirement, making the functional requirement ambiguous and untestable.

SC‑013 states the pipeline must exit with status 0 and produce a manifest.json in ≥ 99 % of runs, but does not specify how many runs constitute the measurement sample or the procedure for counting successes.

SC‑028 requires a user‑test of the Quickstart guide (novice completes audit on 30 URLs within 30 minutes) without defining what qualifies as a “novice”, how many independent users must be tested, or how the timing is recorded, leaving the success criterion vague.
